images.title: One row per money in or money out.

images.title: It tells you when a row is missing something.
images.sub: Rows with no date, no category or a name not on the list are flagged, so you can fix them before the totals are complete.

images.title: See the loss months at a glance.
images.sub: Example: January -$165, February $943, March $608 before the inventory count. Accent bars are losses.
